lead.objective: Synthesize a read-only security, correctness, and cross-domain contract audit of benchmarks/teamwork-vs-squad/fixture/ (gateway/ + worker/ + config.json) without modifying any fixture files.
lead.instructions: In subagent mode, compile specialist payloads via dispatch_squad ({ squadId: "ab_audit", manifestPath: "benchmarks/teamwork-vs-squad/manifest.json" }), launch both specialists via invoke_subagent, and yield via Reactive Wakeup; in wave-gated /swarm mode, read both specialist report slots first. Use bounded read_file calls to cross-verify cited fixture lines independently without modifying fixture files. Preserve 1-ID-per-finding granularity in scratch/agy-squad/squad-ab_audit/lead/report.md with a standalone Content Verdict: PASS line once every P1/P2 defect (file:line, trigger, impact, cross-domain mismatches) is verified. Coordinator runs agy-squad bundle-init --digest, audit-ab-audit, and agy-squad finalize --prune.
lead.expectedDeliverable: Verified synthesis at scratch/agy-squad/squad-ab_audit/lead/report.md with Content Verdict: PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED covering all gateway, worker, and cross-domain defects.

specialists.objective: Perform a read-only line-by-line audit of benchmarks/teamwork-vs-squad/fixture/gateway/ and benchmarks/teamwork-vs-squad/fixture/config.json for P1/P2 security, crash, state/clock drift, test-coverage blind spots, and envelope contract issues.
specialists.instructions: Do NOT modify any fixture files. Inspect your scopeFiles via bounded read_file calls and cite exact file:line ranges, trigger inputs, and expected vs actual behavior.
specialists.expectedDeliverable: Evidence report in your assigned slot listing every P1/P2 defect in gateway/ and any gateway->worker contract mismatches.

specialists.objective: Perform a read-only line-by-line audit of benchmarks/teamwork-vs-squad/fixture/worker/ and benchmarks/teamwork-vs-squad/fixture/config.json for P1/P2 data-loss/persistence, retry/unit logic, test-coverage blind spots, and worker<-gateway contract mismatches.

specialists.expectedDeliverable: Evidence report in your assigned slot listing every P1/P2 defect in worker/ and any worker<-gateway contract mismatches.
